title: Area-code shard A pass — 336 / 339 / 351 / 357
summary: Bounded shard-A area-code organization enumeration covering current U.S. geographic NPAs 336, 339, 351, and 357.

data.research_question: Which current or historically relevant public organizations and organization communication surfaces can be verified in the next unresolved shard-A U.S. geographic NPAs 336, 339, 351, and 357 for the anarchist-violence area-code-hunt workflow?
data.method: Bounded deterministic shard-A enumeration using current NANPA geographic membership, literal and locality-derived public web searches, first-party/current-status checks, public Reddit discovery, repository dedupe, and explicit overlay semantics.
classification_rules: Historical sources are discovery seeds; organizations are not labeled active without current-status evidence.
Do not infer individual political affiliation from proximity, attendance, membership, residence, volunteering, employment, or event participation.
Do not merge organizations or identities from name or handle similarity alone.
For overlay NPAs, locality association does not imply an organization publishes a phone number in the overlay unless directly evidenced.

findings.notes: Greensboro Mutual Aid and etc.gso have current 2026/first-party evidence. Greensboro Food Not Bombs is retained as historical/current-status-unresolved rather than silently promoted.
Current Boston FNB first-party chapter directory lists Malden and Quincy chapters and their public Instagram handles. NPA 339 overlays 781; locality relation does not assert published 339 numbers.

LLAMA Lowell Mutual Aid is current. Existing canonical Lowell/Lawrence ABCF org and investigation target were reused; 2026 ABCF Running Down the Walls independently re-verifies chapter activity in Lowell.

Food Not Bombs Fresno is retained as historical/current-status-unresolved: legacy first-party site exists, but a February 2026 local Reddit status check reports public contact/social surfaces defunct and does not establish active chapter status.
